CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2586 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e. Bus nonce: ef107ce82343a8de954c5225807b79f7. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e` or `Fix review: blocked bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: ef107ce82343a8de954c5225807b79f7`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2586 bb9f93e8bc0d8ed6bf2a9b397c41d378c7d8cf5e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2586-ef107ce8`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2586 (R10-FLOW-DESIGN-POLICY, branch fix/r10-flow-design-policy) at the new head bb9f93e8 (the fixer's round 2 plus a main merge; body re-taken with the nightly-status red answered). Round 1 was blocked (comment 6324652583, class ruling-unmet). Verify with the finder's harness, not the fixer's: (1) decision 0012 now reads as REVOKED per the owner's addendum #201 comment 6322712314, file kept as history, and 0014 item 1 and policy_lint.mjs comments no longer describe a moratorium in force (git grep -iE 'moratorium|0012' outside history); (2) designer.md and design-review.md match the pack at pin 30c57744a (git fetch origin claude/dazzling-gauss-7l3u2b): designer 'A note, not a stop', design-review 'Notes for the fixer are findings, not revise points', 'Decisions are routed, not revised', 'Three notes at most', and the Carry grammar incl. `Carry: dismissed: <reason>` with the colon; the PR's deliberate changes (R17 threshold, 1-h box, design-verdict/<group>) kept; (3) per-file caps and corpus_tokens re-measured (policy_lint --budgets, mutants M1/M4 reproduce), ## Raise justification with Architecture score: dS re-run; (4) ## Red checks answers budget-raise-gate and nightly-status; merge-tree clean. Standing rule 19: every observation ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>` each ending (item <id>); run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
